name: sgs/multi-button
title: SGS Button Group
description: A flexible container for one or more SGS Buttons. Provides per-breakpoint layout, gap, alignment, and wrap controls.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: backgroundOverlayColour/Opacity/OpacityTablet/OpacityMobile/ColourHover/BlendMode are the shared whole-block BACKGROUND PANEL (rendered by class-sgs-container-wrapper.php's sgs_overlay_decls()), not media elements -- same settled reasoning as sgs/container (see its block.json for the full note, 2026-09-03, Bean-directed). Detector rule 37-media-no-handroll's bare `background`/`bg`-prefix discriminator excludes this whole family from supports.sgs.mediaElements by design.

group.label: Button group
group._note: The root IS the flex arranger (own scoped CSS in render.php, not the shared wrapper's grid layer) — layer OUTER is correct per the MF-3 guard, same reasoning as sgs/card-grid's `grid` element. `spacing.margin`/`spacing.padding` are declared (2026-08-13/2026-08-16). `typography` remains an honest gap. `display` is hardcoded to flex in render.php — not attribute-controlled, an honest gap. Background media (image/video/SVG) + overlay colour/gradient render through the shared SGS_Container_Wrapper (D6, universal regardless of kind) — mapped by convention, not every bg sub-attr individually. Attribute names diverge from the default suffix convention (`direction`/`wrap`, not `flexDirection`/`flexWrap`) — every arrangement member is explicitly mapped per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1.

button.label: Button
button._note: Buttons are native InnerBlocks children (`sgs/button`, the only entry in allowedBlocks), each with its own full text/fill/layout controls — this element documents that ownership; multi-button itself controls only the group's own arrangement (see `group`).

childBtnBackground._comment: A2 (D638 SS4/5) -- CSS custom-property GROUP DEFAULT for child sgs/button instances. Emitted as --sgs-mb-btn-bg-default on this block's own wrapper; button/style.css reads it as the second fallback tier of --sgs-btn-bg. Empty = no group default; buttons behave exactly as before.

childBtnBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient GROUP DEFAULT for child sgs/button instances (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Emitted as --sgs-mb-btn-bg-image-default; button/style.css reads it as the fallback tier of --sgs-btn-bg-image, right before button/style.css's own 'transparent'/'none' floor. Empty = no group default.

childBtnBackgroundHover.description: Hover background colour GROUP DEFAULT for child sgs/button instances. Emitted as --sgs-mb-btn-bg-hover-default; button/style.css's own :hover chain previously had no group-default rung at all -- a hover colour set here only ever fell through to the RESTING group default, never a distinct hover one.

childBtnBackgroundHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient hover GROUP DEFAULT for child sgs/button instances. Emitted as --sgs-mb-btn-bg-hover-image-default.

childBtnBorderWidth._comment: 2026-08-30 owner decision -- added alongside childBtnBorderStyle so SgsBorderControl can mount for this group-default row (D338: mounting the composite with a missing sibling attr crashes/discards edits). Box-object shape MATCHES every other SgsBorderControl widthValues attr (e.g. sgs/button's own borderWidth) so the shared control needs no special-casing. Reduced to a single CSS-length shorthand string via sgs_box_object_shorthand() at render time and consumed by a :where(.sgs-multi-button) .sgs-button rule in button/style.css -- zero-specificity ancestor scoping, so it never outranks a preset and never matches a standalone button (see that file's comment for why the base .sgs-button rule itself could not be reused, unlike radius/font-weight).

childBtnBorderStyle._comment: 2026-08-30 owner decision. Default '' (not 'solid', unlike a per-instance borderStyle attr) matches this block's own childBtn* GROUP-DEFAULT convention: empty means no override, so an unconfigured multi-button changes nothing.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
